name: Peisey-Vallandry
description: Peisey-Vallandry sits in the western sector of Les Arcs, closest to the Vanoise Express link to La Plagne. Three sub-villages: Vallandry (main, 1,650m, shops/bars), Plan Peisey (1,900m, closer to main Les Arcs area), and Peisey-Nancroix (traditional hamlet, 1,600m). Forested slopes with long tree-lined intermediate runs. Excellent access to the full 425km Paradiski domain.

overview.atmosphere: Forested intermediate sector of Les Arcs with direct access to Paradiski (425 km). Tree-lined runs, quieter and more relaxed than the main Arc villages.

beyond_skiing.snowshoeing: Ponturin Gorge and Nancroix valley trails
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cross-country skiing, biathlon, paragliding, heritage walks in Peisey-Nancroix traditional hamlet

honest_drawbacks: Requires lifts to reach main Les Arcs ski area
